title: The wheels of time have run over them
author: Kanak Manjari Sahoo
text:
The wheels of time have run over them.
I feel, this is not the place I wished to reach,
Many more miles I have to cover.
I am not sure how far my goal is from hear,
But I walk on, crossing many hurdles,
on my way.
On the either side of my path
Time spreads like a blue sky overhead,
Time spreads like green fields below.

∎
